name: devicerail
description: Language-neutral device automation and test-evidence runtime for Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, desktop, RDP, and Playwright

scripts.fixtures:check: cargo test -p devicerail-protocol --test golden_fixtures && cargo test -p devicerail-schema-gen every_manifest_fixture_validates_against_its_generated_schema
scripts.client:test: pnpm protocol:types:build && cargo build -p devicerail-daemon && pnpm --filter @devicerail/client test
scripts.tool-adapter:test: pnpm client:build && cargo build -p devicerail-daemon && pnpm --filter @devicerail/tool-adapter test
scripts.recorder:test: pnpm client:build && cargo build -p devicerail-daemon -p devicerail-bundle-cli && pnpm --filter @devicerail/recorder test
scripts.live-visualizer:typecheck: pnpm client:build && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer build && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer-app typecheck
scripts.live-visualizer:build: pnpm client:build && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer build && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer-app build
scripts.live-visualizer:test: pnpm client:build && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer build && cargo build -p devicerail-daemon && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer test && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer-app test
scripts.packages:check: pnpm tool-adapter:build && pnpm recorder:build && pnpm --filter @devicerail/live-visualizer build && pnpm --filter @devicerail/yaml-adapter build && node scripts/check-packed-packages.mjs
